subject: incremental build and budgets
outcome: The model is assembled in reusable geometry batches; the first architectural objects are rendered during construction. Pixel ratio is bounded at 1.5, cached shafts share geometry and a browser report records first-batch and total model build timings.
acceptanceCriteriaReviewed: Provide measurable startup/rendering budgets and limit excessive memory or draw calls
Load heavy geometry incrementally and avoid blocking the first useful frame
validation: Architecture unit checks and rendered Chromium desktop/mobile review; relevant scene behavior inspected in source and QA captures.
limits: No quantified field-device benchmark beyond headless Chromium has yet been documented; archive sizes and frame rates are hardware-dependent.

review.note: Deliverable is implemented in independently authored project code and checked against recorded public evidence and browser tests.
